description: The plot illustrates the accuracy of Llama3.3 on PopQA as a function of s_pop frequency, with two distinct lines representing different conditions (likely corresponding to s_pop and o_pop as indicated in the caption). The x-axis, labeled “s_pop frequency (x10^4),” spans from 1 to 19 in linear increments, representing s_pop frequency scaled by 10,000. The y-axis, labeled “Accuracy,” ranges from 0.0 to 1.0 in linear steps of 0.2. The blue dashed line with circular markers starts at approximately 0.75 at x=1, rises to ~0.95 by x=5, remains relatively stable with minor fluctuations around 0.95–1.0 through x=15, dips slightly to ~0.85 at x=13, and then recovers to 1.0 by x=17 and holds steady through x=19. The green solid line with square markers begins at ~0.35 at x=1, increases to ~0.6 at x=5, peaks at ~0.7 at x=7, dips to ~0.45 at x=9, rises again to ~0.65 at x=11, drops to ~0.5 at x=13, and then sharply climbs to 1.0 at x=17, remaining at 1.0 through x=19. Both lines include vertical error bars indicating variability, with larger error bars visible at x=9 and x=11 for the green line.
